description: He wears a long brown textured open front robe over a cream ankle length tunic with fine embroidery at the neck opening. Gold geometric woven borders edge the outer front, cuffs and hem. A broad brown and gold patterned sash wraps the waist and hangs down one side with fringed ends. Long sleeves reach his wrists and both hands hang naturally at his sides. Brown leather shoes show below the tunic; both feet are complete and floor remains visible. His head is bare, without a turban, hood, armor or weapon.
